turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll type END MEETING on its own line, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have twenty minutes, Hale, and a call at 4:40. You gave my son a zero without calling me. Who decided that?
"Thanks for coming in." That isn't an answer. Who decided to enter the zero, and why did I find out from my son's phone?
I'm waiting, Hale. Who entered the zero, and on what basis?
Silence isn't an answer. I have eighteen minutes, and the principal's office is my next stop if I don't get one.

"Hm." Okay, I'll say it for you: the zero goes in the gradebook, nobody calls me, and Owen reads it on his phone in the middle of class. Procedure 4.2 says a parent is contacted before any mark is entered. Did that happen, yes or no?
